summary: Streaming buffer filler driven by a three-state machine stored at *(this+0x180)+0x44 (flattened this+0x1C4): state 0 schedules a new write window, state 1 performs the write dispatch, state 2 flushes. On first use the descriptor init flag *(this+0x1B0) is clear, so an indirect setup call through this+0x184+12 primes the channel and increments the write-cycle counter *(this+0x1CC). Writes dispatch through an indirect call at this+0x188+4 into the current channel data pointer with the fill position and target sizes. When a write window completes, the channel buffer index *(this+0x1C0) is toggled with XOR 1, PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset runs when the cycle counter equals 1, and the state advances to flush. ArrayProcessingWithScaling runs when the cycle counter reaches the limit this+0x118.

local_names.a1: stream object carrying the buffer descriptor and dispatch tables (receiver)
local_names.a2: caller-supplied write parameter forwarded to the dispatch method
local_names.a3: output pointer forwarded to the dispatch method
local_names.a4: output capacity forwarded to the dispatch method

operations.description: First-use guard: when the descriptor init flag *(this+0x180)+0x30 (flattened this+0x1B0) is zero, the one-time channel setup path runs
One-time setup: indirect call through this+0x184+12 (a1[97]+12) passing the current channel data pointer *(*(this+0x180) + 4*index + 0x38); a zero return aborts the function immediately
On successful setup, increments the write-cycle counter *(this+0x180)+0x4C (flattened this+0x1CC) and sets the init flag *(this+0x1B0) to 1
State dispatch on the descriptor state word this+0x1C4: 0 = schedule/init, 1 = write, 2 = flush; a state above 2 returns the running state value unchanged
State 0 (schedule) prepares the next write: fill position *(this+0x1B4) set to 0, write target *(this+0x1C8) set to this+0x114 minus 1, and state *(this+0x1C4) set to 1
When the write-cycle counter *(this+0x1CC) equals the cycle limit this+0x118, ArrayProcessingWithScaling is invoked on the stream object
Write/flush dispatch: indirect call through this+0x188+4 (a1[98]+4) with (a1, current channel data pointer, &fill position *(this+0x180)+0x34, write target *(this+0x1C8), a2, a3, a4)
After dispatch, compares the updated fill position *(this+0x1B4) against the write target *(this+0x1C8); the write is still in progress while the fill position is below the target

State 2 (flush): if the fill position *(this+0x1B4) reaches the write target *(this+0x1C8), the state *(this+0x1C4) returns to 0 and, when the output counter *a3 is still below a4, the schedule path runs again
On completed writes, when the write-cycle counter *(this+0x1CC) equals 1 PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset is invoked (packet guard)
PerIndexBufferCopyWithInterleavedOffset invoked on the stream object for the single-cycle case

Completes the write cycle: toggles the channel buffer index *(this+0x1C0) with XOR 1, clears the init flag *(this+0x1B0), sets fill position *(this+0x1B4) to this+0x114+1, write target *(this+0x1C8) to this+0x114+2, and advances the state *(this+0x1C4) to 2
Returns the partial fill result while a write is incomplete, a4 when the flush saturates the output, or 2 after a completed cycle
